title: Overloads that delegate
prompt:
Create a family of `join` overloads that all delegate to one core:

- `static String join(String sep, String a, String b)`
- `static String join(String sep, String a, String b, String c)`
- `static String join(String sep, String... parts)` — varargs core

Each joins with the separator between items (`join("-", "a", "b")` is `"a-b"`). The two fixed overloads must CALL the varargs one rather than duplicating logic.

tests.name: fixed arities
tests.code:
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.join("-", "a", "b"), "a-b", "two parts");
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.join(", ", "x", "y", "z"), "x, y, z", "three parts");
tests.hint: Separator only BETWEEN items, never at the ends.

tests.name: varargs core
tests.hint: One part prints bare; zero parts is empty.
